answered.sql: SELECT T3.SpeciesName FROM Nature_reserves_flora_and_fauna AS T1 JOIN Flora_and_fauna AS T3 ON T1.FaunaId = T3.FaunaID JOIN Nature_Reserves AS T2 ON T1.NatureReserveId = T2.ReserveID

candidates.meaning: Find the species of flora and fauna that are present in every nature reserve.
candidates.sql: SELECT SpeciesName FROM Flora_and_fauna WHERE FaunaID IN (SELECT FaunaId FROM Nature_reserves_flora_and_fauna GROUP BY FaunaId HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT NatureReserveId) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Nature_Reserves))

candidates.meaning: List the species that are present in all nature reserves.
candidates.sql: SELECT SpeciesName FROM Flora_and_fauna WHERE FaunaID IN (SELECT FaunaId FROM Nature_reserves_flora_and_fauna GROUP BY FaunaId HAVING COUNT(NatureReserveId) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Nature_Reserves))

candidates.meaning: List the species that are present in at least one nature reserve.
candidates.sql: SELECT SpeciesName FROM Flora_and_fauna WHERE FaunaID IN (SELECT FaunaId FROM Nature_reserves_flora_and_fauna)

candidates.meaning: List the species that are present in each nature reserve, including duplicates.
candidates.sql: SELECT T2.SpeciesName FROM Nature_Reserves AS T1 JOIN Nature_reserves_flora_and_fauna AS T2 ON T1.ReserveID = T2.NatureReserveId JOIN Flora_and_fauna AS T3 ON T2.FaunaId = T3.FaunaID
